svg.title: Six diamond pointers, 1 to 49
svg.desc: Forty-nine numbers climbing as six square panels of nine, each turned as a diamond and joined tip to tip. 1 aims forward, with 3 a right point and 7 a left point. 25 is the centre with twenty-four each side. Each number is marked me-parity, other-parity or all-parity by Exhibit ONE.
